area_note: Kharif cotton sown area 109.17 lakh ha vs 109.86 a year earlier (Ministry of Agriculture, as of Sep 4, 2026)

policy.t: Import duty: India waived its 11% cotton import duty from June 1 to October 31, 2026; an extension to December 31 is expected (industry and government sources, Oct 26-27) but not yet notified.
